target.instruction: Pour one centered heart with two rounded lobes, a clear notch, and a tapered point toward the front of the cup.

scoring.quality: max(0, min(mask IoU, boundary F1) - 0.25 * mean foam density in concave target cells)
scoring.concavity: Convex hull of target cell centres minus target. Raw foam density in that region creates a continuous penalty of up to 25 percentage points. No binary concavity veto; no concave cells means zero penalty.
scoring.boundary: Four-connected foreground outline; symmetric F1 within one Euclidean grid cell. Penalized quality, IoU, boundary F1, precision and all serving checks must pass.

target.coordinates: x right, z front; normalized cup radius. Grid rows run from back to front.

space.encoding: Submit exactly 33 normalized numbers in [0,1]. Each physical value = min + p * (max-min); equivalently p=(physical-min)/(max-min). Never submit physical units directly. No clipping. Two model format corrections are allowed before rejecting this episode.

parameters.name: fillVolumeML
parameters.meaning: Nominal total cup volume after high fill, including 36 ml espresso; determines open-loop fill duration, not the final volume. Drawing adds more milk.

parameters.name: fillHeightMM
parameters.meaning: Spout height for the initial centre fill. High pours primarily sink/mix milk rather than paint surface foam.

parameters.name: fillTiltDegrees
parameters.meaning: Pitcher tilt during high fill; higher tilt increases flow.

parameters.name: segment1.x
parameters.meaning: Segment endpoint horizontal position: negative left, zero centre, positive right.

parameters.name: segment1.z
parameters.meaning: Segment endpoint depth position: negative back (top of map), positive front (bottom).

parameters.name: segment1.heightMM
parameters.meaning: Requested endpoint spout height. Low 10–30 mm pours deposit surface foam; high pours mix. Cup rim limits effective height when cup is low.

parameters.name: segment1.tiltDegrees
parameters.meaning: Endpoint pitcher tilt: <=25 stops flow, larger tilt increases flow to a maximum at 85. Interpolates from previous endpoint.

parameters.name: segment1.durationSeconds
parameters.meaning: Time moving linearly from the previous endpoint to this one, including height and tilt changes. Repeat position/height to hold; positive tilt can continue depositing.

space.execution: Fixed preparation and nominal high fill, followed by six continuous linear segments. Each endpoint sets position, height and tilt; each segment sets its duration. Controls interpolate from the previous endpoint at 60 Hz, starting at the high-fill position with tilt zero. Repeated endpoints hold steady; tilt <=25 stops flow. Final 0.5s settling pause, then serve. No sensor feedback or controller calls during execution.
